name: Business/Entrepreneur Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Full business registration certificate and investment certificate of the company.

requirement_groups.name: Recurring applicant -- held the permit at least twice (5-year permit)

requirements.blocker_text: Has already held a temporary resident permit under this category at least twice, plus a Rwanda Revenue Authority tax clearance certificate.

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years (new applicants); up to 5 years (recurring applicants, held the permit twice before)

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE), Rwanda -- business/investor permits: sectors include mining, agriculture, manufacturing, hospitality, IT, transport/logistics; 150,000 RWF/2yr new, 250,000 RWF/5yr for applicants who have already held the permit twice with RRA tax clearance; applications via irembo.gov.rw

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Rwanda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 DGIE sourced. NO MINIMUM INVESTMENT THRESHOLD FIGURE was disclosed by DGIE's own pages -- this is a genuine gap disclosed rather than estimated, consistent with this dataset's practice elsewhere (Botswana, Chad, Mongolia, Cote d'Ivoire investor routes had the same gap). This is DISTINCT from a citizenship-by-investment scheme: Rwanda's nationality law separately lists 'substantial sustainable investments' as one of eleven independent grounds for citizenship (see rw_citizenship_special_grounds.json) -- a genuine, faster route exists alongside this ordinary residence-permit track, and the two should not be conflated. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months inferred the same way as rw_work_permit.json.
